name: Accessible Union-Closed Family
statement: A finite nonempty family $\mathcal A\subseteq2^X$ is an antimatroid when it is accessible and union closed: every nonempty $A\in\mathcal A$ has some $a\in A$ with $A\setminus\{a\}\in\mathcal A$, and $A\cup B\in\mathcal A$ for every $A,B\in\mathcal A$. Its one-inclusion graph is a learning-space graph.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty family; inactive coordinates may be discarded.
